public.text: There is perhaps a need between available technology and generic health system goals to separately (rather than directly associated with) describe the generic capabilities specific technologies should fulfil so that the tendency to look for off the shelf solutions is minimised
public.suggestedRevision: Goals should determine capabilities which should be fulfilled by technologies. The work already undertaken and described in 467-473 appears to be too tied to delivery and does not achieve sufficient separation between defining/developing an ideal and delivering working solutions (the currrent status quo)
